svg.title: Allocate a $45,000 Startup Plan Without Hiding Vendor Float
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-45000-reference; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $45,000 Startup Plan Without Hiding Vendor Float; subtitle: Four buckets total $45,000 within the $15,000–$75,000 USD range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: numeric_value encodes the $45,000 central/reference startup allocation. Matching lean allocations total $15,000 and expanded allocations total $75,000, as detailed in each bucket. All amounts are USD. These are startup capital envelopes, not the Conservative, Base, and Scaled annual revenue scenarios. Displayed percentages are rounded to one decimal place.; caption: The $45,000 reference plan separates vendor settlement float from operating reserves and setup spending; startup cash is not revenue. First deals may take 3–9 months, so recalculate runway against actual spending and vendor terms rather than assuming any envelope funds the entire wait.; stages: label: Vendor settlement float; value: $18,000 reference allocation; 40.0% of startup cash; numeric value: 18000.0; detail: Lean envelope: $6,000; expanded envelope: $30,000. Cover the gap between vendor payment and customer settlement. Do not accept orders whose uncovered exposure exceeds available cash and confirmed credit capacity.; label: Operating cash reserve; value: $12,000 reference allocation; 26.7% of startup cash; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Lean envelope: $4,000; expanded envelope: $20,000. At the canonical $5,000–$25,000 monthly operating range, this $12,000 reserve covers 2.4 to 0.48 months before receipts, excluding separately allocated vendor float.; label: Vendor enablement and delivery; value: $9,000 reference allocation; 20.0% of startup cash; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Lean envelope: $3,000; expanded envelope: $15,000. Fund required certifications, documented demonstration environments, deployment runbooks, and limited specialist preparation for the chosen product family.; label: Commercial systems and setup; value: $6,000 reference allocation; 13.3% of startup cash; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Lean envelope: $2,000; expanded envelope: $10,000. Establish CRM, quote templates, accounting integration, insurance, contract review, and focused account research without committing to broad paid acquisition.
